'''EV 3D3''' was the designation of a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="SWTOR" /> around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Dates" /> when it was destroyed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
EV 3D3 appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Coruscant. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means it was destroyed.
